name: online.antigravityreset/antigravity-resets
title: Antigravity Resets
description: Read-only Google Antigravity global quota reset tracker, X announcement history, and limit rules.

tools.name: get_latest_reset
tools.description: Return the latest verified Google Antigravity global quota reset announced on X, elapsed days since that reset, any active official watch banner, and historical cadence statistics. Read-only community record; does not predict future resets.

locale.description: Language for human-readable summaries. Default en.

tools.name: get_reset_timeline
tools.description: List verified Google Antigravity global quota resets since May 2026, newest first, with primary X source URLs and interval gaps. Optionally filter by model pool, trigger reason, date range, and limit.

model.description: Case-insensitive filter on affected model pools (e.g. Gemini, Argon, Claude, All models).

reason.description: Case-insensitive filter on reason tags (e.g. incident, product release, maintenance).

limit.description: Maximum number of reset events to return (1-50, default 10).

locale.description: Language for human-readable summaries. Default en.

tools.name: get_quota_rules
tools.description: Return verified Google Antigravity quota refresh baselines (Free, Google AI Pro, Google AI Ultra), 5-hour vs 7-day weekly cap mechanics, Gemini CLI shared pool facts, and stuck-quota troubleshooting steps.

locale.description: Language for returned rules and troubleshooting copy. Default en.
